company.name: Firecrawl
company.shortDescription: Firecrawl is an API service that designs structured data for integration.
company.description: Firecrawl converts websites into clean, AI-ready data through a unified API. It provides functionality to crawl entire websites or scrape individual pages, returning outputs in markdown, structured data (JSON), HTML, screenshots, and more. It handles dynamic content, JavaScript-rendered pages, proxies, rate limits, and caching behind the scenes to simplify integration for developers. It supports integrations with popular AI frameworks and tools, including LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Zapier, offering flexible usage across different environments.
